Definition: Jareb, a symbolical name for Assyria
BiblicalUsage: Jareb is a symbolic name for Assyria, the king Israel ran to when Ephraim saw his sickness and Judah saw her wound. Hosea says the king could not heal them or cure their wound, and the calf of Bethel would be carried to Assyria as a present to king Jareb.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that running to Assyria for healing is the same as running to any power but God, and it never cures the wound.
